_readme: Narration delivery for the pilot (generate_story_audio.py). Voice + speed come from the story's teller; emotion comes from its tone.dominant via tone_emotions (a per-teller "emotion" key overrides). sentence_pause_ms inserts an SSML <break/> at each sentence boundary inside a paragraph — paragraph-to-paragraph gaps are NOT here, they're a player setting (BujuPilot.narration in pilot/js/stories.js), so they can be tuned without regenerating. Cartesia's most reliable emotions are neutral, calm, content, sad, scared, angry; happy/excited/triumphant and ~50 more exist but are less predictable — an emotion Cartesia rejects is dropped for that clip with a warning. Changing speed/emotion/sentence_pause_ms makes existing mp3s stale: regenerate with --force (the script warns you).
